header.command: cargo xtask gr3-run --arm A --set core --mode renders --budget 8000 --workers 8 --marks 250,500,750,1000,1250,1500,1750,2000,2250,2500,2750,3000,3250,3500,3750,4000,4250,4500,4750,5000,5250,5500,5750,6000,6250,6500,6750,7000,7250,7500,7750,8000 --endpoint 4000 --equivalent-seconds 60 --rate-source TP's cost table (docs/r3.md, 'The per-evaluation cost on R1's engine', 2026-10-21, cargo xtask bank cost under flock -x at load 8.7-10.9, an upper bound on cost): with effects an evaluation costs about 50 ms per second of clip on 1 worker and 8 workers give about 4.3x, so 60 s on 8 workers is about 5,000 renders for a 2 s clip and 2,000 for a 5 s one; create's default budget of 4,000 renders is 'about 60 s on 8 workers for a 2-3 s clip of a patch with effects' (66.7 renders/s) --bank /home/vboxuser/code/enth-scratch/r23/f1s/bank/enth-bank-v1.bin --note arm-A core baseline: render-equivalent estimate (no quiet window; coordinator's option b); recorded to 8,000 renders so a measured idle rate up to 133 renders/s converts without running again
